title: Working with Tables and Graphical Elements

activities.title: Add the workshop schedule to your letter
activities.intro: Open your formatted letter from 2.2 and add the schedule table. Tick each step as you finish it.

items: After the first body paragraph, type Here is the schedule: and press Enter.
Insert a table: 3 columns x 6 rows.
Type the header: Time, Tab, Activity, Tab, Venue.
Fill in the 5 time slots using Tab (see the schedule text in Stuck?).
Apply a table style, or shade the header row.
Double-click column borders to fit, then Ctrl + S.

blocks.prompt: How many columns does your table have?
How many rows does it have, counting the header row?
Which key moves the cursor to the next cell?
In your table, what is in the Venue cell for the Lunch break?
Optional: a screenshot of your schedule table

help: Schedule: 8:30 to 9:00 AM · Registration · Lobby, Ground Floor | 9:00 AM to 12:00 NN · Word processing · Conference Room | 12:00 NN to 1:00 PM · Lunch break · Pantry | 1:00 to 2:30 PM · Spreadsheets · Conference Room | 2:30 to 4:30 PM · Presentations and closing · Conference Room
Table landed inside a paragraph? Undo, add an empty line first, then try again.
Pressed Enter and the row got taller? Enter makes a new line in the same cell. Use Tab to move on.
Table too wide? Use AutoFit, then fit it to the window.

activities.title: Add a letterhead with a logo or graphic
activities.intro: Build a simple letterhead in the header of your letter. Tick each step as you finish it.

items: Double-click the top margin to open the header (Docs: Insert › Headers & footers › Header).
Insert a picture: a sample logo from the training folder, or Insert › Icons in Word.
Resize it from a corner to about 2 to 3 cm wide.
Put the office name beside it (borderless 2-column table, or Square wrap), then move the office name lines from the letter body into the header.
Close the header, check the whole page, and Ctrl + S.

blocks.prompt: Which handle do you drag so the logo keeps its shape?
About how wide should the logo be?
options: The full width of the page

blocks.prompt: Why do we put the letterhead in the header and not in the body?
options: The header repeats on every page by itself
Pictures cannot go in the body

blocks.prompt: Optional: a screenshot of your letterhead

help: Picture is huge and fills the header? Drag a corner handle, or set the width in Picture Format › Size.
Finished early? Add a caption above your schedule table.

blocks.prompt: You made the logo smaller and now it looks squashed. What happened, and what's the fix?
options: The file is corrupted; insert it again from the internet
Change the wrapping to Behind Text
A side handle was dragged; undo and resize from a corner
Zoom out until it looks normal
